notes: With-skill runs achieve 100% pass rate across all 3 evals vs 32% baseline average
The skill's primary value is enforcing standardized documentation (SOURCES.yaml, DATA_DICTIONARY.md, .gitignore, .env.example) — without it, agents produce functional scripts but ad-hoc documentation
Baseline runs sometimes produce equivalent content under non-standard names (codebook.md vs DATA_DICTIONARY.md, README_data_sources.md vs README.md) — the skill enforces naming conventions
Script quality (download logic, API usage) is comparable between with/without skill — the differentiation is in project scaffolding and reproducibility artifacts
With-skill runs are slightly faster on average (-29s) and use fewer tokens (-5K), likely because the structured workflow reduces exploration/backtracking
